customer.business: Village Basket (working name): daily pooled grocery run with a village pickup point, Amchit and the Jbeil hill villages
customer.target: Households in Amchit and the hill villages above it in Jbeil district (Bejjeh, Ghalboun, Aabaydat, Kfoun) who do their main grocery shop at the Jbeil supermarkets or top up at the village mini-market, in a cash-tight economy where median household income is about $550 a month and food takes about a third of spending
customer.where: Amchit (Aamchit) and the hill villages of Jbeil district, Mount Lebanon

segments.name: Amchit-centre household, 5 to 6 minutes by car from Spinneys, Tawfeer MAX and Le Charcutier in Jbeil
Hill-village household (Bejjeh, Ghalboun, Aabaydat or Kfoun), 20 to 25 minutes by car from the Jbeil supermarkets
Older person or couple who rarely or never drives
Comfortable family on two salaries or remittances from abroad

behaviours.name: Weekly big shop
behaviours.how: Drives down to Spinneys or Tawfeer in Jbeil once a week and fills the boot.

behaviours.name: Daily mini-market top-up
behaviours.how: Buys bread, labneh and a few items at the village dekkene most days, pays a little more for convenience, sometimes on a running tab.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Follows Tawfeer and supermarket offers on Instagram and WhatsApp, compares prices, stocks up when there is a deal.

behaviours.name: Commuter
behaviours.how: Works in Jbeil, Jounieh or Beirut and stops at a supermarket on the way home.

behaviours.name: Picky about fresh food
behaviours.how: Insists on choosing their own vegetables, fruit and meat; does not trust anyone else to pick.

behaviours.name: Relies on family or neighbours
behaviours.how: Does not drive; a son, daughter or neighbour brings the shopping.

behaviours.name: Delivery app user
behaviours.how: Sometimes orders from Toters or a supermarket's own app.

pitch:
Village Basket: a twice-weekly grocery run for Amchit and the villages above it (Bejjeh, Ghalboun, Aabaydat, Kfoun), run by a neighbour from Amchit.
Every Tuesday and Friday. Send your list on WhatsApp, as text or a voice note, by 9 p.m. the night before, or just reply "same as last time". We send back each item and an estimated total before we shop.
Staples only: packaged food, dairy, cleaning and baby items, bought together at Tawfeer MAX Jbeil at its quantity and carton prices. We don't pick fresh vegetables or meat; you keep choosing those yourself.
You pay the normal single-item shelf price minus half of the bulk saving, plus $1.25 a bag, and no fee on your first bag. Every bag comes with the till receipt and a slip showing the shelf price, what we paid and what you saved.
Collect it from 5 to 9 p.m. or the next morning at the partner mini-market in your village, or have it left at your door for $1.50 more.
Check your bag when you collect it: anything wrong or damaged, hand it back and you don't pay for it. Pay cash or Whish; after your third bag you can settle once a week.
